verdict.rationale: Downloadable API specs are a fair question for a SaaS CRM, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence that Sales Cloud publishes a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on salesforce.com returning 404, and the generic 'Discover Salesforce APIs' marketing line does not show a spec. The probe only checked the marketing domain, so a spec hosted elsewhere is not ruled out, which keeps confidence at medium.
